title: Code Review Companion
description: Reviews pasted code for bugs, readability, and edge cases like a thoughtful teammate.

title: Bug Hunter
description: Walks through a stack trace and reasoning to help pin down root causes.

title: API Design Advisor
description: Reviews REST/GraphQL API shapes for consistency and evolvability.

title: Regex Whisperer
description: Writes and explains regular expressions for the pattern you describe.

title: DevOps Runbook Assistant
description: Drafts incident runbooks and deployment checklists from a description of your stack.

title: Unit Test Writer
description: Drafts unit tests for a function, including sensible edge cases you might miss.

title: Commit Message Coach
description: Turns a description of your changes into a clean, conventional commit message.

title: CSV Data Detective

title: Algorithm Tutor
description: Explains classic algorithms and data structures with worked examples.
